backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing feature requests, user profiles, announcements, assignments with blob storage, study planner tasks with date/time/priority, and access control with admin/user permissions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four requirements to remove automatic paragraph-to-multiple-bullet conversion UI and logic from Notes Cleaner while preserving basic formatting, definition style, headings auto-detect, and all existing UI controls.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages (HomePage, AssignmentFormatPage, StudyPlannerPage, NotesCleanerPage with three formatting checkboxes and auto-clear behavior, LeaveApplicationPage, ResumeBuilderPage, RequestFeaturePage), components, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Contains the single numeric value '73' representing the current production draft version.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documentation for production version management explaining that production-version.txt contains a single numeric draft version to promote to Live/Production channel via metadata-only CI/CD operation.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with soft purple/blue primary colors and student-friendly aesthetics.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, 'StudentSathi Student Helper Website' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component configuring TanStack Router with seven routes (home, assignment-format, study-planner, notes-cleaner, leave-application, resume-builder, request-feature), ThemeProvider with light default theme, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Multi-language assignment chatbot component with voice input/output, image upload via Tesseract OCR, chat interface with suggestions, and download options for PDF/Word/Text formats.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header, responsive navigation (desktop and mobile sheet menu), and footer. Includes links to all app pages and branding for StudentSathi.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: Reusable Button component with variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link) and sizes (sm, default, lg, icon). Supports asChild prop for composition.
Card component primitives including Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter with consistent styling.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: Sheet (side drawer) component with context-based state management, supporting left/right/top/bottom sides, overlay backdrop, and close button.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: Placeholder Toaster component that returns null; intended for future toast notification implementation.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: Chat assistant component with voice input, image OCR (Tesseract.js), text-to-speech, and assignment generation workflow. Manages conversation state, confirmation dialogs, and integrates with backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: Documentation file indicating DailyProgressChart.tsx should remain unchanged during weekly chart fixes.
Displays daily task progress with a donut chart showing completed vs pending tasks, plus a stats grid with total tasks, completed, pending, and total time.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Wrapper component that conditionally renders DailyProgressChart or WeeklyProgressChart based on viewType prop.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Renders a colored badge for a subject using color mapping utility, displaying subject name with custom or default styling.
A searchable dropdown component for filtering study tasks by subject, displaying subject names with task counts and highlighting the selected subject.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: Displays a donut chart and statistics grid showing weekly study progress, including total/completed/pending tasks and total study time for completed tasks only.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout, managing identity state and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query mutations and queries for feature requests, assignment generation (frontend-only), conversation saving, and study planner task management (add/update/delete/fetch).
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: Hook that persists study planner sort mode ('default' or 'dateTime') to localStorage and provides getter/setter for the preference.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: Hook that independently persists subject filter state for daily and weekly views in localStorage, returning the filter and setter for the active view.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: Hook that persists the study planner view mode ('daily' or 'weekly') to localStorage, defaulting to 'weekly' if no preference exists.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color schemes, including primary, secondary, accent, destructive, and sidebar colors using HSL values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, rendering the main App component.
Feature-rich assignment formatting tool with multi-language UI support, title page editor, format settings (font, spacing, page numbering), content editor with word count, AI improvement, and export to PDF/Word/Text formats. Includes subject-specific heading templates, reference helpers, and teacher checklist.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero section and grid of six tool cards (Assignment Format, Study Planner, Notes Cleaner, Leave Application, Resume Builder, Request Feature) with navigation to respective pages.
Leave application generator that takes student name, date, and reason as inputs and produces a formatted leave letter with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: Notes cleaning tool that converts rough notes into formatted text with options for bullet points, definition style, auto-detect headings, and download as text file with custom filename.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: Feature request form allowing users to submit suggestions for new tools with optional email contact, using a mutation hook to persist requests to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: React component for a resume builder form that collects personal info, education, skills, and projects, then generates a formatted text resume that can be copied to clipboard.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: Main Study Planner page component with task management (add/toggle/delete), view switching (daily/weekly), sorting, subject filtering, progress charts, and PDF/TXT export functionality for both authenticated and guest users.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Defines bullet style configuration for Notes Cleaner, currently locked to dash style with functions to get bullet prefix and current style.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Provides text formatting utilities for Notes Cleaner including auto-detecting headings, applying definition styles, and splitting text into sentences with bullet points.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Handles TXT file download for cleaned notes with auto-generated or custom filenames based on first word and current date.
Utility functions to parse duration strings (e.g., '1.5 hours') into minutes and format minutes back into human-readable duration strings.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: Manages localStorage-based guest task storage for Study Planner with CRUD operations, legacy task migration, and support for daily/weekly view types.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Generates a formatted HTML document from study tasks and opens it in a new window for printing to PDF, including task details, completion status, and summary statistics.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting functions for study tasks by either creation order (default) or chronological date/time, with stable tie-breaking using task IDs.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Handles conversion between HTML date/time inputs and backend timestamp formats (bigint nanoseconds), and formats date/time values for display.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Exports study tasks to a plain text file with formatted headers, task details, and summary counts, triggering a browser download.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Provides utilities for weekly date calculations including normalizing backend bigint and guest number timestamps, determining current week boundaries (Monday-Sunday), and checking if dates fall within the current week.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Manages a centralized mapping of academic subjects to color schemes, providing functions to retrieve badge and indicator color classes for UI components with dark mode support.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Extracts and manages URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state across navigation and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings for borders, shadows, animations (accordion), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata indicating this is a fix request to remove automatic paragraph-to-multiple-bullet conversion logic while preserving basic bullet formatting, definition style, and heading detection features in the Notes Cleaner utility.
unknown.txt: Requirements document describing an Assignment Format page with fixed template structure, editor features (word counter, download options), subject headings panel, citation helper, teacher checklist, and an embedded Student Sathi Assistant chatbot with context-aware help and assignment generation capabilities.
